what: CDISC's five example study definitions in USDM 4.0.0, from the DDF reference architecture: the protocols study.builder's reader is held to. The CDISC pilot study (LZZT) is the one it was first written on.
license_note: DDF-RA's README gives two licences: MIT for code and scripts, CC-BY-4.0 for content files, and says neither gives trademark permission. The example study definitions are data, and are treated here as content. No code or script of DDF-RA's is copied.
attribution: Content based on DDF-RA (GitHub), https://github.com/cdisc-org/DDF-RA, used under the CC-BY-4.0 licence.
changes: The five files here are CDISC's, unchanged, each held to its checksum. The protocols made from them (protocols/*.protocol.json) are changed: read by study.builder's reader and cut down to what a simulated study follows.
